name: Pixel Evidence Reader
description: Convert local images into deterministic text grids, structure fingerprints, pixel samples, palettes, and region crops for text-only models.

display_description.en: Inspect local images without external calls using pixel grids, measured structure, exact samples, dominant colors, and reproducible region zooms.
display_description.zh: 无需外部调用，通过像素网格、结构测量、精确采样、主色和可复现区域放大来检查本地图像。

default_init_input.en: Read this local image with pixel evidence:
default_init_input.zh: 用像素证据读取这张本地图像：

quick_inputs.en: Scan this image and explain its measured layout and colors:
quick_inputs.zh: 扫描此图并解释测得的布局和颜色：

quick_inputs.en: Sample exact pixels at these coordinates:
quick_inputs.zh: 精确采样这些坐标处的像素：
裁剪并重新扫描此区域：

display_description.en: Produce bounded luminance/color grids and structure metrics.
display_description.zh: 生成有界亮度/颜色网格和结构指标。

display_description.en: Read exact or locally averaged pixel values.
display_description.zh: 读取精确或局部平均像素值。

display_description.en: Export a selected region as PNG for reproducible zooming.
display_description.zh: 将所选区域导出为 PNG，便于可复现放大。
